Inkwell 1.1.0 adds document tabs, folder search and a visual editing mode that keeps Markdown syntax hidden as you type.

## Highlights

- **Document tabs.** Work on several files at once. Each tab keeps its own edits, selection, scroll position and undo history. Closing the window checks every tab for unsaved edits.
- **Visual editing.** Edit formatted text and cells in rendered tables directly. Visual editing, Live Markdown and Source share one document and undo history. Visual editing is the default for profiles without a saved mode.
- **Search.** Find text in the current document, filter outline headings, or search the contents of Markdown and text files in the open folder and its subfolders. Selecting a folder search result opens the file at the matching line.
- **Changes on disk.** Open documents refresh and retain the cursor, selection and scroll position where possible. If a file changes while you have unsaved edits, Inkwell pauses autosave and lets you save your edits elsewhere or reload from disk.
- **Session preferences.** Inkwell remembers the chosen editing mode, the previous formatted mode for switching out of Source, and the window size and maximized state.

## Downloads

| Platform | Download |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | [Installer](https://github.com/kainpl/inkwell/releases/download/v1.1.0/Inkwell-1.1.0-windows-x64-setup.exe) · [Portable ZIP](https://github.com/kainpl/inkwell/releases/download/v1.1.0/Inkwell-1.1.0-windows-x64-portable.zip) |
| Linux x64 | [Debian package](https://github.com/kainpl/inkwell/releases/download/v1.1.0/Inkwell-1.1.0-linux-x64.deb) · [AppImage](https://github.com/kainpl/inkwell/releases/download/v1.1.0/Inkwell-1.1.0-linux-x64.AppImage) |
| macOS | [Universal DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel](https://github.com/kainpl/inkwell/releases/download/v1.1.0/Inkwell-1.1.0-macos-universal.dmg) |

Extract the Windows portable ZIP into a writable folder and run `Inkwell.exe`. Keep the `data/` folder when updating an existing portable installation. Both Windows editions use Microsoft Edge WebView2.

On Linux, make the AppImage executable before running it. On macOS, open the DMG and drag Inkwell to Applications.

The Windows builds are unsigned and the macOS build has no Apple notarization. Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may prompt at first launch. [SHA-256 checksums](https://github.com/kainpl/inkwell/releases/download/v1.1.0/SHA256SUMS.txt) are available for all downloads.
